stableGraphAdapter.name: tail-original-stored-shared-stable-graphs-v1

frozenCalibrationAdapter.name: frozen-binary-calibration-lookup-v1
frozenCalibrationAdapter.scope: Saved binary alpha_n only for n<160. All original source cells, far transfers, graphs, physical quadrature and arithmetic order are retained. Global warp alpha is the saved binary datum. No recalibration, truncated head, new deep metric or nonlinear solution.

storedMetricAdapter.name: tail-original-stored-metric-bounded-points-v1
storedMetricAdapter.scope: The saved original binary alpha_n and global warp alpha are reused through a source-hash-locked lookup. All original physical formulas, arithmetic order, 160 cells and auxiliary far transfers remain; five- and seven-fraction historical fingerprints are checked. No rational deep replacement or physical recalibration.
